title: The Lives of Others (bc30)
synopsis: In 1984 East Berlin, dedicated Stasi officer Gerd Wiesler begins spying on a famous playwright and his actress-lover Christa-Maria. Wiesler becomes unexpectedly sympathetic to the couple, and faces conflicting loyalties when his superior takes a liking to Christa-Maria. When conflict is bound to erupt, between justice, love, and life, which one is the most fragile?

synopsis_lang.en: In 1984 East Berlin, dedicated Stasi officer Gerd Wiesler begins spying on a famous playwright and his actress-lover Christa-Maria. Wiesler becomes unexpectedly sympathetic to the couple, and faces conflicting loyalties when his superior takes a liking to Christa-Maria. When conflict is bound to erupt, between justice, love, and life, which one is the most fragile?
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1984年的東德，大阿哥的耳目仍無處不在。秘密警察韋斯勒上尉，活在封閉的體制下，每天只為政府工作，將真相埋藏。劇作家基約戴文身處滿佈線眼的世界裡，但以維護公義為己任，朝思暮想希望將事實公諸於世。女星姬絲斯蘭面對複雜的人生，甚麼也不想知，只想安份守己地過日子，祈盼在別人懷裡找到安穩的感覺。 一個政府秘密特工、一個極具才華的劇作家、一位美艷女星，三人走在一起，令衝突一觸即發，各人應樣怎樣自處？公義、愛情、生命到底哪樣比較脆弱？

cast: Ulrich Mühe, Martina Gedeck, Sebastian Koch
